diagnosis.summary: The IR specifies a repeating cycle with a 3-minute period. The candidate used `period: 0` (one-shot) and lacked the re-arming logic to repeat the body every 3 minutes. Evidence F2 shows the IR emitted an action at 190000ms (after the first cycle), but the candidate emitted nothing because it terminated after the initial execution.
diagnosis.change_summary: Changed `period` from 0 to 180000 (3 minutes). Rewrote the script to be a repeating body that performs the actions and then implicitly waits for the next period start. Removed the trailing `delay(3 MIN)` which was incorrectly acting as a termination delay rather than a cycle period.
